text.title: 最后的奖赏
text.objectives: 将你的光铸头盔与光铸胸甲交给德莉亚娜。
text.description: 这真是个令人惊异的故事，$N！我实在是太感谢你了，其它一些与此有关的人也会对你表示真心诚意的感激。或许今天晚上我就能睡个安稳觉了。$B$B这儿还有些你绝对会很喜欢的东西，送你算作奖励吧。
text.progress: 依照我们的约定，你准备好交出你的光铸装备来换取全新的魂铸头盔和胸甲了吗?
text.completion: 我会想念你的，$N。我欠你很大一份人情;我想我永远也无法报答你。$B$B希望你喜欢你的新头饰和胸甲，也希望它能保护你很长一段时间。
text.completed: 去铁炉堡找王座厅的德莉亚娜。

english.title: Saving the Best for Last
english.objectives: Give Deliana your Lightforge Helm and Lightforge Breastplate.
english.description: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
english.progress: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Lightforge pieces in exchange for your new Soulforge Helmet and Breastplate?
english.completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.$B$BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

text.objectives: 将你的野性之心兜帽与野性之心外衣交给莫克瓦尔。
text.description: 确实是个令人惊异的故事，$N！我实在是太感谢你了，其它一些与此有关的人也会对你表示真心诚意的感激，这一点我向你保证。你的努力使我们终于认识到了自己过去所犯的错误。$B$B这儿还有些你绝对会很喜欢的东西，送你算作奖励吧。
text.progress: 你准备好用你的野性之心装备和我交换全新的野兽之心风帽和外衣了吗?
text.completion: 我真的会很想你，$N。我欠你一份人情，这是我永远也无法回报的。$B$B好好使用你的新头饰和胸甲。愿它能保护你很长一段时间，为你带来更多的荣耀!
text.completed: 去找奥格瑞玛的莫克瓦尔。

english.title: Saving the Best for Last
english.objectives: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
english.description: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
english.progress: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Wildheart pieces in exchange for your new Feralheart Cowl and Vest?
english.completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.$B$BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

text.title: 挑战
text.objectives: 到黑石深渊的竞技场去，在你被裁决者格里斯通宣判之后将挑战之旗插在场地中央。杀死塞尔德林和他的角斗士，然后将瓦塔拉克饰品第一部分交给东瘟疫之地的安泰恩·哈尔蒙。
text.description: 听好了，$N。为了让这面旗帜运转起来，你必须要进入黑石深渊的竞技场，然后听任裁决者格里斯通宣判你，然后将这面旗子牢牢地插在地面上有处挑战标记的地方。$B$B这时你想挑战的人就会被不可抗拒的力量推入战场，浑身上下只有将你杀死的欲望。当你从他身上找到了你要的东西以后，就回去找安泰恩吧。
text.progress: 你回来了，$N!
text.completion: 你取回了部份的勋章了吗，$N?
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找斯坦索姆的安泰恩·哈尔蒙。

english.title: The Challenge
english.objectives: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.  Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
english.description: Heed me well, $N.  For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths.  Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.$B$BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you.  Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.

text.title: 完美的毒药
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥要塞的德尔克·雷木让你把温诺希斯的毒囊和库林纳克斯的毒囊交给他。
text.description: 我和我的兄弟在拉文霍德庄园外进行毒药研究。$B$B拉文霍德公爵命令我们研制一种极效混合毒药，祖尔格拉布和安其拉废墟出产这种毒药的原料，也就是毒囊。$B$B有两只剧毒的野兽居住在那些可怕的废墟中，它们很可能有我们需要的毒囊。$C，去取回库林纳克斯和温诺希斯的毒囊，我们会永远记得你的恩情的。
text.progress: 这不是个简单的任务，$N。你需要带些朋友去。
text.completion: 拉文霍德感谢你，英雄!带着你的奖励走吧!
text.completed: 去希利苏斯找塞纳里奥要塞的德尔克·雷木。

english.title: The Perfect Poison
english.objectives: Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.
english.description: My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.$B$BLord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.$B$BThere are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, $c. Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.
english.progress: This ain't no smash and grab job, $N. You're gonna need to bring friends.
english.completion: Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! Take your pick!

text.title: 阿瑞斯坦的预感
text.objectives: 将1瓶古龙水和1瓶香水交给暴风城贸易区的摩根·匹斯特。
text.description: 我找到了！你闻到过风中的新香气没有？新的香水现在有那么流行么？我们的卫兵不该这么简单就这样抛弃他们的职责！$b$b嗯，一定是因为他们的理智完全被这些该死的炼金术产品所盖过去了。$b$b要想搞清楚问题，只有一个办法：弄一些香水的样本，把它们交给摩根·匹斯特，并把我的推断告诉他。别担心，你回来的时候我会把买香水的钱付给你的。
text.progress: 有什么能帮你的吗?
text.completion: 我了解艾里斯坦的疑虑，但我真的觉得他反应过度了。让年轻男女做他们想做的事吧。我想艾里斯坦已经忘了年轻和恋爱的感觉。$B$B不过还是不要告诉他比较好。我们就迁就他吧。
text.completed: 去找暴风城的摩根·匹斯特。

english.title: Aristan's Hunch
english.objectives: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Morgan Pestle in the Trade District of Stormwind.
english.description: I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.$B$BThat is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.$B$BThere is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
english.progress: Something I can help you with?
english.completion: I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. Let young men and women do what they will. I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.$B$BBut it would be better not to tell him that. We'll humor him.

text.title: Morgan's Discovery
text.objectives: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
text.description: Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.$B$BIt isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
text.completion: While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. We must carefully consider our next move.$B$BHere, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.

text.title: Tracing the Source
text.objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Allison at The Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
text.description: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
text.completion: Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.$B$BIf you ask me, it's kind of boring. Everyone smelling the same? It smells great, but still.

I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.$B$BHe mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.

text.title: The Source Revealed
text.objectives: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the Hillsbrad Foothills behind Ravenholdt Manor.
text.description: What? Treason? No, no. I assure you, my intentions are completely harmless.$B$BIs it so wrong to help those who wish to ease the painful ritual of courtship? Come, that is no crime.$B$BAnd to prove that I mean no harm, I will even tell you my source.$B$BThey were shipped to me by a Staffron Lerent, an apothecary of some sort. I never spoke with him.$B$BOur goblin middle man said that he worked in the foothills over Hillsbrad past that mysterious Ravenholdt Manor. I wish you luck in finding him.
text.completion: Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.$B$BOnce the warriors of Alliance and Horde alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the Shadow Council.$B$BThey will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.$B$BThe solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.

Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire.  He was never heard of again.$B$BSeek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now.  I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.

text.title: 战争的回响
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者要你杀死5个畸形妖、5只岩肤石像鬼、8个死亡骑士队长和3只毒性捕猎者。
text.description: 上一次战争距今已有5年了……$B$B数万名士兵战死沙场，他们的牺牲换来了什么？危机远远没有消失。$B$B巫妖王再次蠢蠢欲动……他的走狗克尔苏加德正在集聚军队，准备对我们的家园发动新一轮的袭击。$B$B我们绝不会让他得逞！拿出你的奉献精神吧。勇敢地投入战斗，以此证明你的无畏！银色黎明和血色十字军组成的联军将是你坚强的后盾和战友。$B$B转至纳克萨玛斯的宫殿，打败天灾军团……
text.progress: 职责，荣誉，奉献……这些字眼对你而言有什么意义?
text.completion: 做的好!你会因为替圣光之愿的男男女女牺牲奉献而获得奖励。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者。

english.title: Echoes of War
english.objectives: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to slay 5 Living Monstrosities, 5 Stoneskin Gargoyles, 8 Deathknight Captains and 3 Venom Stalkers.
english.description: Five years since the last war...$B$BTens of thousands of lives were lost and for what? The threat was never fully extinguished.$B$BAnd so the Lich King stirs once more... His yes-man, Kel'Thuzad, amassing for another attack upon our lands.$B$BWe will not allow it! Prove your dedication. Prove that you are willing to risk life and limb to stop this madness and the combined might of the Dawn and the Crusade will be at your beck and call.$B$BEnter Naxxramas and destroy the Scourge within...
english.progress: Duty, honor, dedication... What do these words mean to you?
english.completion: A job well done! You will be rewarded via the services of the men and women at Light's Hope.

text.description: 杀死纳克萨玛斯城中的敌军首领之后，你会在他们的尸体上发现阵亡英雄的遗骸。将那些被亵渎的遗物、板甲碎片和其它材料交给我，也许我能试着删除护甲上的诅咒，重新为你打造一件精良的护甲。
text.progress: <艾利格抬头看着你又继续说。>
text.completion: <艾利格指着他的头。>$B$B戴好罩帽，$C。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者。

english.title: Redemption Headpiece
english.objectives: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 5 Arcanite Bars and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.
english.description: You will find the remnants of our fallen heroes on the corpses of the Lords of Naxxramas. Bring those desecrated keepsakes to me along with wartorn plate scraps and crafting materials capable of revitalizing the cursed armor and I shall craft a fine piece of armor for you.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: <Eligor points to his head.>$B$BKeep it covered, $C.

text.completion: 任何圣骑士都会告诉你，他们冲击的力量来自于肩膀。越大越好……

text.title: 毒性测试
text.objectives: 将魔暴龙之刺扎入一只魔暴龙的体内。
text.description: 这些你帮我制造的毒素有着特殊的用途。环形山里的魔暴龙使得那里的狩猎和生存环境对我来说都变得十分恶劣。即使我足够强壮，杀死一只魔暴龙也只会让另一只游荡入那块带领地而已。$b$b带上这根毒针并将其刺入一只活着的魔暴龙体内。毒素会使它很快就安静下来，不过……我不知道很快有多快……
text.progress: 你驯服那头野兽了吗?
text.completion: 感谢你，$N。你很勇敢也很有智慧。$B$B跟我说说看那个恶龙的毒性反应如何?
text.end: 把毒刺扎入魔暴龙体内
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的托尔瓦·寻路者。

english.title: Toxic Test
english.objectives: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
english.description: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.$B$BTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
english.progress: Were you able to pacify the great beast?
english.completion: Thank you, $N.  You are brave and wise.$B$BTell me, how did the devilsaur react to the toxin?

text.title: 血瓣毒药
text.objectives: 收集一些血帽和格里什钉刺，然后向托尔瓦·寻路者复命。
text.description: 我要你帮我制作一批毒素，用来制服某些生活在环形山里的巨兽。它并非是致命性的，不过只有一个足够细心和聪明的$c才能收集到所有的材料。$b$b在环形山里任意血瓣花苗身上，你都可以找到一些血帽蘑菇，而格里什钉刺则可以从环形山南部巨痕谷中的那些巨蜂身上找到。
text.progress: 成功了吗?
text.completion: 终于拿到了材料!$B$B有了安戈洛的泥土，调制毒素就变的轻而易举……
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的托尔瓦·寻路者。

english.title: Bloodpetal Poison
english.objectives: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a $c can hope to collect the ingredients.$B$BYou can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the insects inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
english.progress: Have you met with success?
english.completion: The ingredients at last!$B$BWith the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...

text.title: 更好的材料
text.objectives: 从沉没的神庙底部的守卫身上得到一些腐烂藤蔓，把它们交给托尔瓦·寻路者。
text.description: 这正是我所担心的，看来毒素的力量还是太弱了，无法对这样强大的生物产生影响。$b$b我们必须造出一种更强力的毒素，你需要转至阿塔哈卡神庙的底部，揭开那个祭坛的秘密，并从那里的守卫身上取一些腐烂的藤蔓来。神庙很危险，我建议你带些朋友一起去。$b$b完成之后回到我这里来吧。
text.progress: 你拿回藤蔓了吗?
text.completion:
这毒素终于完成了。我不敢
再像之前一样过份，要你对这生物下毒手。$B$B你赢得了我的感谢与尊敬，祝福你一路顺风，$N。
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的托尔瓦·寻路者。

english.title: A Better Ingredient
english.objectives: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
english.description: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$B$BIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$B$BReturn to me when this is done.
english.progress: Have you recovered the vine?
english.completion: At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.$B$BYou have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, $N.

text.title: 地穴追猎者外套
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的外套、25块锁甲碎片、4块奥金锭和3个熟化毛皮交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的猎手雷奥普德，他会为你制作一件地穴追猎者外套。
text.description: 我发现地穴恶魔的甲壳大有用处。我可以利用这种甲壳以及丢失在纳克萨玛斯宫殿中的被玷污的护甲，打造出一套轻便时尚的、具有毁灭性力量的套装。$B$B帮我寻找必需的材料，我就能制作出这套前所未有的装备！
text.progress: 你有我要的物品了吗，$C?
text.completion: 他们会畏惧你，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的猎手雷奥普德。

I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.$B$BBring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!

text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: <罗汉让你看他的移动。>$B$B这是什么，$N?为了之后的竞争我必须正中这个记号。
text.completion: 拿去吧，$r。如同先前允诺的，骨镰胸甲。我希望服装专家不在附近。你可能会因为穿着这个被丢进监狱!
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Breastplate
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Breastplate if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 6 Cured Rugged Hides.
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: Exellent $N !$B,you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Bonescythe Breastplate.

text.title: 骨镰腿铠
text.objectives: 如果你将1副被玷污的腿铠、20块皮甲碎片、1块奥金锭、8个熟化毛皮和100金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一副骨镰腿铠。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: <罗汉笑着。>$B$B我了解了这整个事情的讽刺之处。
text.completion: 戴着这东西要小心一点。你可能会伤了自己。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Legplates
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Legplates if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legplates, 20 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 8 Cured Rugged Hides and 100 gold pieces.
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: <Rohan laughs.>$B$BI just realized the irony in all of this.
english.completion: Be careful walking around in those things. You might cut yourself.

text.title: 骨镰头盔
text.objectives: 如果你将1顶被玷污的头盔、15块皮甲碎片、8个熟化毛皮、1块连结水晶和75金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一顶骨镰头盔。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: 你要给我钱。$B$B<罗汉笑着。>$B$B那还是能打动我。
text.completion: 我的骨镰盔帽和胡力欧的不同之处在于格调，$N。格调……
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Helmet
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Helmet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Helmet, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 8 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 75 gold pieces.$B
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: Exellent $N !$B,you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Bonescythe Helmet.

text.title: 骨镰肩铠
text.objectives: 如果你将1副被玷污的肩铠、12块皮甲碎片、5个熟化毛皮、1块连结水晶和50金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一副骨镰肩铠。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: <罗汉很怀疑地看着你。>$B$B你最近去过提尔之手?
text.completion: <罗汉将眉毛上的汗珠擦掉。>$B$B这些护肩费了不少功夫!不要走出去像个呆子一样被人杀了，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Pauldrons
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Pauldrons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 50 gold pieces.
english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
english.progress: <Rohan eyes you suspiciously.>$B$BBeen to Tyr's Hand lately?
english.completion: <Rohan wipes the sweat from his brow.>$B$BThese shoulders took some work! Don't go out and get yourself killed like a scrub, $N.

text.title: 骨镰马靴
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的马靴、12块皮甲碎片、3个熟化毛皮、2块连结水晶和25金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一双骨镰马靴。
text.description: 如果你想要骨镰护甲，就得帮我找来一些必需的材料。$B$B进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿——就是那座漂浮在空中的巨大城市，去收集被玷污的护甲和皮甲碎片。集齐所有材料，我就能为你打造骨镰护甲。噢，对了，你还得付点金币给我……制作护甲所需的骨头由我来提供。
text.progress: 赶快把材料带给我不要再浪费我的时间了，$C。
text.completion: 他们穿在你脚上很适合。对了，你最近没有再去提尔之手了吧?
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.description: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. english.progress: Just bring me the materials and stop wasting my time, $C.
english.completion: They go on your feet. Say, you haven't been nosing around in Tyr's Hand again, have you?

text.title: 骨镰护手
text.objectives: 如果你将1双被玷污的护手、8块皮甲碎片、1块奥金锭和5个熟化毛皮交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗，他会为你制作一双骨镰护手。

text.progress: 没有我需要的物品，你要我怎么做出什么东西来?
text.completion: 这些护手必要时可能可以替换武器。骄傲的穿戴上它们吧!
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.progress: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
english.completion: These gauntlets could probably substitute as weapons if absolutely necessary. Wear them with pride!

text.completion: 腰带准备好了，$N。你有看过这样高品质的物品以如此低价出售吗?
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.progress: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
english.completion: The bracers are ready, $N.$B$B<Rohan bows.>

text.title: 末日之影
text.objectives: 转至一处召唤法阵，杀死一名末日之影，然后向东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉复命。
text.description: 在你攻破天灾军团的召唤法阵后，就要面对守护法阵的侍僧了。$B$B说老实话，这些家伙不是人，而是暗影，巫妖王最恐怖的爪牙。使用死灵石可令它们显形，魔法和武器攻击都能取它们的性命。
text.progress: 运气如何，$N?
text.completion: 做得漂亮，$N。随着暗影被摧毁，我们对抗巫妖的胜利希望也得以保存。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉。

english.title: Shadows of Doom
english.objectives: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.$B$BIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
english.progress: Have you had any luck, $N?

text.title: 梦游者外套
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的外套、25块皮甲碎片、6个熟化毛皮和2块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵，他会为你制作一件梦游者外套。
text.description: 许多英雄在那场战争中丧生，直到今天还有无数勇士前赴后继，与天灾军团进行殊死的搏斗。天灾士兵们从阵亡的英雄身上脱下护甲，带回纳克萨玛斯进行秘密研究。$B$B取回那些被玷污的护甲碎片和我需要的其它材料，我就能为你打造梦游者护甲。
text.progress: 材料虽然昂贵，但你很快就不会放在心上了。
text.completion: 你的梦行者外套准备好了，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵。

english.title: Dreamwalker Tunic
english.objectives: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Tunic if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals.
english.description: Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.$B$BRecover the desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps and supply to me the other material components I require and I will craft Dreamwalker armor.
english.progress: The material cost is high, but soon forgotten.
english.completion: Your Dreamwalker Tunic is ready, $N.

text.progress: 材料虽然昂贵，但你很快就不会放在心上了。
text.completion: 如我所允诺的，梦行者腿甲。$B$B<瑞恩将护甲交给你。>
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵。

text.title: 霜火长袍
text.objectives: 如果你将1件被玷污的长袍、25块布衣碎片、4张月布和2块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯，她会为你制作一件霜火长袍。
text.description: 作为一名守卫，我有权使用麦迪文的私人物品。我发现在所有的物品中，书籍最能予人启迪。坦白地说，虽然大部分书籍内容都相当垃圾，但其中也不乏精品。其中一本记载了大法师的霜火套装的制作方法。$B$B<安吉拉指着她的脑袋。>$B$B它们现在都在我的脑子里，如果你能给我适当的材料，我会很乐意与你分享这些宝贵的知识。
text.progress: 有了适宜的材料和试剂，我就能制作神话般的霜火护甲了。
text.completion: 别忘了未受抑制的力量和未被使用的力量具有一样的毁灭性，$C。穿上霜火护甲时要谨慎使用。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: Frostfire Robe

english.description: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.$B$B<Angela points to her head.>$B$BIt's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.

text.title: 霜火腕轮
text.objectives: 如果你将1副被玷污的腕轮、6块布衣碎片、1块奥术水晶和1块连结水晶交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯，她会为你制作一副霜火腕轮。
text.description: 作为一名守卫，我有权使用麦迪文的私人物品。我发现在所有的物品中，书籍最能予人启迪。坦白地说，虽然大部分书籍内容都相当垃圾，但其中也不乏精品。其中一本记载了大法师的霜火套装的制作方法。$B$B<安吉拉指着她的脑袋。>$B$B它们现在都在我的脑子里，如果你能给我适当的材料，我会很乐意与你分享这些宝贵的知识。
text.progress: 有了适宜的材料和试剂，我就能制作神话般的霜火护甲了。
text.completion: 别忘了未受抑制的力量和未被使用的力量具有一样的毁灭性，$C。穿上霜火护甲时要谨慎使用。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: Frostfire Bindings
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Bindings if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.
english.description: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.$B$B<Angela points to her head.>$B$BIt's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: Exellent $N !,$Byou got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Frostfire Bindings.

text.title: 瘟疫之心长袍

text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的愤怒者玛塔乌斯。

text.description: <蒙托尔神父在你面前做了一个奇怪的手势。>$B$B幸运的$G小伙子:姑娘;，你找到那些阵亡士兵的护甲了吗？这些可怜的英雄在那场战争中咽下了最后一口气，还被天灾士兵脱去了所有护甲，连死亡的尊严都没能保住。$B$B把被玷污的护甲部件和净化所需的材料给我带来，你就会了解信仰的含义。
text.progress: 你帮我把试剂带来了吗，孩子?
text.completion: 装备准备好了，$N。用你的公正之火将那些伤害我们世界的人击溃。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的英尼戈·蒙托尔神父。

english.title: Circlet of Faith
english.objectives: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Circlet of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
english.description: <Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.>$B$BBlessed $g boy:girl;, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity.$B$BBring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.
english.progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
english.completion: Exellent $N !$B, you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Circlet of Faith.

text.title: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad
text.objectives: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
text.description: The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.$B$BSomeone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?

text.title: 恐怖之城，纳克萨玛斯
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯需要5块奥术水晶、2块连结水晶、1个正义宝珠和60金币。你在银色黎明中的声望必须达到尊敬。
text.description: 病木林深处就是纳克萨玛斯的宫殿入口。那儿的符文传送门被魔法结界笼罩，一般人是根本进不去的，不过现在不一样了。$B$B我们已经想出了破除结界的方法——奥术掩码。我对肯瑞托古老的咒语进行了一些修改，使它具备了破除纳克萨玛斯结界的能力。但是你在银色黎明的声望还不高，$N，因此你需要支付一大笔钱。或者当你的声望达到崇敬或是崇拜时再来找我，我会给你打折的。
text.progress: 从没有人能进入纳克萨玛斯还活着讲他的故事。
text.completion: 你会感到一点刺痛，$N。那种感觉就表示它发挥作用了。完成之后，你就能踏上病木林里的符文传送门进入纳克萨玛斯。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.$B
english.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, $N, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
english.progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.
english.completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

text.title: 地穴追猎者护甲的材料……
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的猎手雷奥普德要30份地穴魔的碎块。
text.description: 你想赚到这些亮闪闪的玩意儿吗？$B$B<雷奥普德举起一枚十字军徽记。>$B$B我有点小麻烦，或许你能帮得上忙，$N。瞧，我会为那些敢于进入纳克萨玛斯宫殿的勇士们制作地穴追猎者套装。虽然他们能为我提供所需的主要材料，但是我还需要地穴魔的碎块。把一组碎块交给我，我会送你一枚十字军徽记作为奖励的，这东西在军需官那儿大有用处。
text.progress: 狩猎的如何?
text.completion: 啊，这会很适用，$N。记住，我永远都会接受更多的部位。你每给我一束，我就会奖励你一枚徽记。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的猎手雷奥普德。

english.title: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...
english.objectives: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Crypt Fiend Parts.
english.description: How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?$B$B<Leopold holds up an insignia of the Crusade.>$B$BI've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, $N. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into Naxxramas. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.
english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Ah, that'll do nicely, $N. Remember, I'm always accepting more parts. For every bundle you bring me, I'll reward you with an insignia.

text.title: 地穴魔的碎块
text.progress: 你的第一批货是个示范性的成就，$N。如果你有更多，我现在就会收下它们。你每交给我一束，我就会用一枚徽记奖励你。
text.completion: 非常好，$N!这些绝对会很有助益。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的猎手雷奥普德。

english.title: Crypt Fiend Parts
english.progress: You did an exemplary job on the first bundle, $n. If you have more, I will take them now. For every bundle that you turn in, I will reward you with another insignia.
english.completion: Most excellent, $n! These will definitely come to good use.

text.title: 骨镰的材料
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的洛汉要30个白骨碎片。
text.description: 打造胡里奥的骨镰护甲需要大量白骨碎片。虽然那些勇敢的家伙们已经从纳克萨玛斯的宫殿中为我取回了重要材料，但是我还需要白骨碎片。$B$B你觉得怎么样？想接受这项任务，顺便杀些天灾士兵吗？这可是件双赢的好事儿。
text.progress: 我可以指引你去骷髅遍布的地方，$C。
text.completion: 你工作的很快，$N。快的跟狐狸一样……嘿，我有跟你说过我在美容沙龙四重唱的日子吗?$B$B提醒我最近找一天跟你说那个故事。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bonescythe Digs
english.objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.$B
english.description: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.$B$BSo what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
english.progress: I can direct you to skeleton infested locales, $c.
english.completion: You work fast, $N. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was in a barber shop quartet?$B$BRemind me to tell you that story one of these days.

text.title: 白骨碎片
text.progress: 我的人手里从没有人能拥有许多骨头碎片，$N。不论何时，只要你有多馀的碎片，把它们带来给我，我就会用另一枚徽记奖励你。
text.completion: 我在加基森的舞厅当全职舞者的梦想终于要实现了!继续努力，$N。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的杀手洛汗。

english.title: Bone Fragments
english.progress: A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, $n. Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia.
english.completion: My dream of becoming a full-time dancer at the Gadgetzan disco is soon to become a reality! Keep up the good work, $n.

text.title: 元素交易
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯要30个元素之核。
text.description: 冒险者，你好啊！你对这儿的工作感兴趣吗？如果你替我做事的话，我会给你这些徽记作为报酬的。你可以用它们在军需官那里购买各种物品。$B$B我只需要元素之核，越多越好！$B$B你在整个艾泽拉斯世界都可以找到形状尺寸各异的元素之核。
text.progress: 我只能将你引入正途，$N。
text.completion: 做的好，$N!如同先前允诺的，徽记是你的了。只要记住，还有很多熔火……
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: The Elemental Equation
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.$B
english.description: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.$B$BAll I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!$B$BYou'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
english.progress: I can only steer you in the right direction, $N.
english.completion: A job well done, $N! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...

text.title: 元素之核
text.progress: 说实话，我用熔核来制作霜火护甲。这是法师用来对抗纳克萨玛斯的护甲。如果没有你和其它像你一样的人，我们大概绝对会输掉这场战役。$B$B说到这，如果你给我更多熔核，我就会给你更多徽记。
text.completion: 你为我们奉献许多，$N。做的好!
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。

english.title: Core of Elements
english.progress: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.$B$BWith that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.
english.completion: You perform a great service for us, $n. Well done!

text.title: 无畏护甲的材料
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的科尔法克斯要30个黑铁碎片。
text.description: 你有见过无畏套装吗，$C？噢，你当然没有见过。你还是个$G小伙子:姑娘;，孩子。让我来告诉你吧，无畏套装是一套象征着荣耀的护甲。$B$B你或许会问，这跟你有什么关系呢？我要说的是，如果你有黑铁碎片的话，我会很乐意统统买下的。$B$B我需要这些碎片为勇士们打造无畏套装。把碎片给我，你会得到报酬的。
text.progress: <柯菲斯对你咆哮。>$B$B你想要什么?指导?我可以提供……
text.completion: 就当前而言，这已足够。如果你又有更多，你知道可以在哪里找到我。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的科尔法克斯，圣光之勇士。

english.title: Binding the Dreadnaught
english.objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
english.description: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, $c? No, of course you haven't. You're still a $g boy:girl; - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.$B$BYou're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.$B$BI need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
english.progress: <Korfax growls at you.>$B$BWhat do you want? Directions? I can provide those...
english.completion: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.

text.title: 黑铁碎片
text.progress: 你每给我一堆碎块，我就会给你一枚徽记 - 越多越好。在我把你碎成两半之前快离开我的视线!
text.completion: 你只带了这些来给我?你可能没听清楚我说的话。我要更多!
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的科尔法克斯，圣光之勇士。

english.title: Dark Iron Scraps
english.progress: For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. Now get out of my sight before I split you in two!
english.completion: That's all you brought me? Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. I need MORE!

text.title: 蛮荒之叶
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵需要30片蛮荒之叶。
text.description: 我会为那些进入纳克萨玛斯宫殿的勇士们打造一套名为梦游者的护甲。他们能为我提供大多数材料，但是我还需要来自艾泽拉斯某种植株的蛮荒之叶。$B$B你或许认为这项任务太过容易，但是蛮荒之叶是打造梦游者套装的必备材料。$B$B如果你能完成任务，我还会让你挑选一枚银色黎明徽记或是十字军徽记作为奖励。
text.progress: 我非常熟悉我们世界的植物群。你需要指导吗?
text.completion: 我很感激，$N。$B$B<瑞恩鞠躬。>$B$B请记得我永远都会收受藻叶。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵。

english.title: Savage Flora
english.objectives: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.
english.description: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.$B$BYou may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.$B$BI am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.$B
english.progress: I have intimate knowledge of the flora in our world. Do you require direction?
english.completion: I am much obliged, $N.$B$B<Rayne bows.>$B$BPlease remember that I am always acceptINg fronds.

text.title: 蛮荒之叶
text.progress: 你每给我一束藻叶我就会给你一枚黎明徽记或十字军徽记。$B$B徽记可以交给军需官换取不同的奖励。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。你的贡献对我们成功战胜天灾军团极为重要。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的莱茵。

english.title: Savage Fronds
english.progress: For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.$B$BInsignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Your work is vital to the success of our campaign against the Scourge.

text.title: 梅兹的文书
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的物资官员梅兹要一枚银色黎明勇气勋章。
text.description: 你想要文书？什么？你认为多少人梦寐以求的文书仅仅是用来炫耀的吗？你错了，无知的家伙。世界各地的工匠们都想要为前线战事贡献自己的一份力量。$B$B如果你想拿到订单的话，就得证明你愿意投身这项事业。将一枚勇气勋章交给我吧。$B$B惟有杀戮能让你这卑微的家伙了解真相。
text.progress: <指挥官梅兹抽着他的雪茄。>$B$B有什么事吗?我是个大忙人。
text.completion: 好，这是它使用的方式:你每交出一枚勇气勋章，我就会给你另一个令状。你要完成令状上的任务并将它交给军需筹备官石汉。懂了吗?很好。现在快滚吧。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的物资官员梅兹。

english.title: They Call Me "The Rooster"
english.objectives: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.$B
english.description: You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.$B$BIf you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.$B$BAnd there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
english.progress: <Commander Metz chews on his cigar.>$B$BWhat is it? I'm a busy man.
english.completion: Alright, here's how it works: For every valor token that you turn in, I'll give you another writ. You complete the order on that writ and deliver the order to Packmaster Stonebruiser. Got it? Good. Now get out of here.

text.title: Craftsman's Writ
text.description: You know the drill, kid. One valor token gets you a craftsman's writ.
text.completion: You earned this, scrub. Now, don't cry about your orders. Fill 'em or destroy 'em.

english.title: Craftsman's Writ
english.description: You know the drill, kid. One valor token gets you a craftsman's writ.
english.completion: You earned this, scrub. Now, don't cry about your orders. Fill 'em or destroy 'em.

text.title: 阴影之下
text.objectives: 在你的地图上寻找天灾入侵的地区。击败浮空城周围的天灾士兵，摧毁一处浮空城。将10块死灵石交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉。
text.description: 那些漂浮在空中的天灾浮空城污染了部落和联盟的土地。塔纳利斯、诅咒之地、冬泉谷和燃烧平原都笼罩在它们的阴影之下。$B$B我们只有协力作战，才能消灭敌人。$B$B在天灾入侵之地，有多处魔法阵支持着这些浮空城。我们决定要攻破法阵周围的防御势力。
text.progress: 要战胜这个威胁需要一些时间。你的进展如何，$N?
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。透过持续增加的获胜记录，我们将可以战胜巫妖王和他的手下。$B$B休息一下养精蓄锐，但你之后务必要再次回到前线，以免我们损失了今天才夺回的土地。$B$B为了在日后的战役中帮助你，我们会用特别的物品和你交易更多的亡域符文。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的指挥官托马斯·海勒拉。

english.title: Under the Shadow
english.objectives: Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The floating necropolises of the Scourge plague the lands of Horde and Alliance alike. Tanaris, the Blasted Lands, Winterspring and the Burning Steppes are blanketed in the shadows of the flying fortresses.$B$BOnly through our combined efforts will they be turned away.$B$BThe necropolises are supported by magical circles at various points in the invaded areas. We have determined that destroying the mindless hordes that surround these circles will destroy their defenses.
english.progress: It will take time to prevail against this threat. How have you fared, $N?
english.completion: You've done well, $N. Through these incremental defeats, we shall prevail against this renewed Scourge threat.$B$BRest and recover, but then you must head out to the front again, lest we lose the ground we have gained today.$B$BTo aid you in your further battles, we will make some of our special items available to you in trade for more necrotic runes.

text.title: Light's Hope Chapel
text.objectives: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
text.description: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before.  This must be the doing of the Lich King!  The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.$B$BIf we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
text.progress: You've come to join our order, have you not?
text.completion: The Argent Dawn placed the call for aid, and you, among others, have answered. There is no time for us to provide you with training. Our faith is placed in your abilities, and that you will join us in throwing back this Scourge threat.

english.title: Light's Hope Chapel
english.objectives: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before.  This must be the doing of the Lich King!  The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.$B$BIf we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.progress: You've come to join our order, have you not?
english.completion: The Argent Dawn placed the call for aid, and you, among others, have answered. There is no time for us to provide you with training. Our faith is placed in your abilities, and that you will join us in throwing back this Scourge threat.

text.title: 通行文书
text.objectives: 将签过字的通行文书交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的物资官员梅兹。
text.description: 要是没有那些探险者的帮助，我的商队肯定难逃此劫！天灾士兵突然从黑暗中显身，拦住了我们的去路。$B$B<卫兵迪迪尔擦了擦眉毛上的汗水。>$B$B现在我们得在这儿等待查博斯元帅。他会在你的通行文书上签字，之后你就要返回圣光之愿礼拜堂找物资官员梅兹。$B$B$N，在查博斯元帅面前说话可得小心点。他是那种一怒起来就会冲过来砍下你的脑袋再吐口痰的家伙——而且他真的会这么做……
text.progress: 报上名字，军阶还有编号!
text.completion: <发送指挥官梅兹接过令状并签署。>$B$B做的好，$N。可以说是相当杰出!收下这个以表我们的感谢。别说客套话了，小鬼。

english.title: Writ of Safe Passage
english.objectives: Deliver the signed Writ of Safe Passage to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Without the help of adventurers, my caravan would have never made it! Scourge were coming out of the woodwork to try and stop us from getting here.$B$B<Guard Didier wipes his brow.>$B$BNow we need to wait here for Field Marshal Chambers to arrive. He'll sign your writ of safe passage to take back to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel.$B$BAnd $N, watch what you say around Chambers. He's the 'bite off your head and spit down your wind pipe' type of guy - except that he'll actually do it...
english.progress: Name, rank and serial number!
english.completion: <Dispatch Commander Metz takes the writ and signs it.>$B$BExcellent work, $N. Outstanding even! Take this as a token of our appreciation. No pun intended, scrub.

text.title: 工匠文书 - 致密平衡石
text.objectives: 将120个致密平衡石和工匠文书 - 致密平衡石交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤。
text.description: 工匠文书的持有者在完成订单后可以挑选一枚徽记作为奖励。$B$B订单BS-091：$B$B120个致密平衡石。$B$B所有的成品应送到东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤处。$B$B物品若有任何损坏，订单无效。$B$B银色黎明物资官员梅兹
text.progress: 完成工作令了吗，$C?
text.completion: 是的，这些东西会成为步兵易于操作的攻击武器。

english.title: Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone
english.objectives: Deliver 120 Dense Weightstones and the Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order BS-091:$B$B120 Dense Weightstones.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
english.progress: Filling a work order, $C?
english.completion: Yep, these will come in handy for the infantry's bashin' weapons.

text.title: 工匠文书 - 君王板甲护胸
text.objectives: 将3个君王板甲护胸和工匠文书 - 君王板甲护胸交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤。
text.description: 工匠文书的持有者在完成订单后可以挑选一枚徽记作为奖励。$B$B订单BS-428：$B$B3个君王板甲护胸。$B$B所有的成品应送到东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤处。$B$B物品若有任何损坏，订单无效。$B$B银色黎明物资官员梅兹
text.progress: 完成工作令了吗，$C?
text.completion: 有更多的护甲给我们的军队!太棒了，$N!

english.title: Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest
english.objectives: Deliver 3 Imperial Plate Chests and the Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order BS-428:$B$B3 Imperial Plate Chests.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
english.progress: Filling a work order, $C?
english.completion: More armor for the troops! Fantastic, $N!

text.title: 工匠文书 - 火山战锤
text.objectives: 将3把火山战锤和工匠文书 - 火山战锤交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤。
text.description: 工匠文书的持有者在完成订单后可以挑选一枚徽记作为奖励。$B$B订单BS-697：$B$B3个火山战锤。$B$B所有的成品应送到东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤处。$B$B物品若有任何损坏，订单无效。$B$B银色黎明物资官员梅兹
text.progress: 完成工作令了吗，$C?
text.completion: 这些东西和我们储备的致密平衡石会配合的很好。

english.title: Craftsman's Writ - Volcanic Hammer
english.objectives: Deliver 3 Volcanic Hammers and the Craftsman's Writ - Volcanic Hammer - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order BS-697:$B$B3 Volcanic Hammers.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
english.progress: Filling a work order, $C?
english.completion: These should go well with the dense weightstones we're stockpiling.

text.title: 工匠文书 - 巨型瑟银战斧
text.objectives: 将3把巨型瑟银战斧和工匠文书 - 巨型瑟银战斧交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤。
text.description: 工匠文书的持有者在完成订单后可以挑选一枚徽记作为奖励。$B$B订单BS-6020：$B$B3个巨型瑟银战斧。$B$B所有的成品应送到东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的马队管理器布鲁斯·石锤处。$B$B物品若有任何损坏，订单无效。$B$B银色黎明物资官员梅兹
text.progress: 完成工作令了吗，$C?
text.completion: 这些东西没有我想象中巨大。不过，我信守承诺。

english.title: Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe
english.objectives: Deliver 3 Huge Thorium Battleaxes and the Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order BS-6020:$B$B3 Huge Thorium Battleaxes.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
english.progress: Filling a work order, $C?
english.completion: These aren't as huge as I expected. Regardless, a deal is a deal.

text.title: 野性戒卫 - 防护秘药
text.objectives: 祖尔格拉布的无眠者赞扎需要一份防护秘药。
text.description: 赞扎可以使用适当的材料对你的装备进行古老的魔法增强处理！你听说过野性戒卫吗？啊，你当然没有听说过。你满脑子都是那些低级的暗夜精灵的魔法。$B$B给我拿来一份暗夜精灵的秘药，我也许能重新为你附魔。去吧，我会把野性戒卫作为奖励送给你的。
text.progress: 拿到秘纹了吗?
text.completion: 看到这些无用的精灵魔法让我更加的愤怒而这些愤怒也能让我获得更多的力量。$B$B再去多拿一些秘药来给我，你就能获得另一个野蛮护卫。
text.completed: 去找祖尔格拉布的无眠者赞扎。

english.title: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
english.objectives: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Protection.
english.description: Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.$B$BBring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.$B
english.progress: Do you have the arcanum?
english.completion: The worthless magic in these enchantments fuels my anger. My anger gives me strength.$B$BBring me more and you shall receive another Savage Guard.

text.title: 寒冰戒卫
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的愤怒者玛塔乌斯需要10枚十字军徽记和30金币。
text.description: 啊，寒冰戒卫。它可以在某些护甲表面生成稀薄的魔法保护光环。寒冰戒卫能在你遭受冰霜系的攻击时起到额外的保护作用。$B$B愤怒者玛塔乌斯的创造物总是相当昂贵的，就算你哭着求我，我也不会降价。你感兴趣吗？
text.progress: 如果没有这些银色黎明的卫兵在这，我一定把你打到屁滚尿流。
text.completion: <麦特斯将金币收进口袋。>$B$B往后的修理费用可不便宜，$r。纳克萨玛斯对那些不熟悉的人可是没有那么仁慈。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的愤怒者玛塔乌斯。

english.title: The Ice Guard
english.objectives: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.
english.description: Ah, the Ice Guard. It is a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. Those that do battle with creatures of frost and ice will gain increased protection from their attacks by using the Ice Guard.$B$BAs with all things the Wrathcaster creates, there is a price - a price that I will not lower, regardless of how much you whimper. Interested?
english.progress: If it were not for these Argent Dawn guards, you would be a stain upon this floor.$B$B
english.completion: <Mataus pockets the gold.>$B$BEnjoy the repair costs, $R. Naxxramas is 'unkind' to the uninitiated.

text.progress: <施怒者麦特斯大吼>$B$B滚开，无知的人，除非你有我需要的东西。
text.completion: <麦特斯将金币收进袍内。>$B$B你还站在这做什么，$r? 我们的交易已经结束了。

And like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard is going to cost you a good amount of money.$B$B<Mataus holds his hand out and rubs his fingers together.>$B$BInterested?

english.completion: <Mataus stuffs the gold into his robe.>$B$BWhat are you still standing around for, $R? Our business is done.

text.title: 精良的作战装备 - 银色黎明友善
text.objectives: 如果你有30枚银色黎明徽记和30枚十字军徽记，就能从银色黎明的宝藏中挑选一件物品。
text.description: 朋友，你好。你想要用银色黎明徽记或十字军徽记换取这些物品吗？$B$B我得提醒你，如果你在银色黎明的声望只达到友好的话，这笔交易可是要收取很高的附加费的。我建议你跟银色黎明创建更高的声望之后再实施你的计划。
text.progress: 小心选择，这可是没办法退货的。
text.completion: 祝你有个美好的一天，$N，很高兴和你做生意。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的军需官米兰达·布利洛克。

text.title: 拉玛兰迪的命运
text.objectives: 进入纳克萨玛斯的宫殿，找到拉玛兰迪的下落。
text.description: 拉玛兰迪是兄弟会的一名战士，早在银色黎明成立之前他便是莫格莱尼阁下的学生了！当莫格莱尼的死讯传来时，仇恨和愤怒充斥着他的心灵。$B$B试想一下吧，$N，一个被复仇的怒火占据了心灵的人还能算个人吗，无非是个被情绪操控的傀儡。拉玛兰迪在盛怒之下冲进了纳克萨玛斯的宫殿，想为恩师报仇……可惜是肉包子打狗。$B$B转至纳克萨玛斯的宫殿打探拉玛兰迪的下落吧。
text.progress: 有罗马拉丁尼的消息吗?
text.completion: 这就是他的戒指没错!不过光芒却已不在。你还有找到其它罗马拉丁尼的物品吗?$B$B<柯菲斯露出痛苦的表情。>$B$B这样看来罗马拉丁尼应该是凶多吉少了。不过这戒指……应该还能恢复他原有的光芒。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的科尔法克斯，圣光之勇士。

english.title: The Fate of Ramaladni
english.objectives: Enter Naxxramas and uncover the Fate of Ramaladni.
english.description: Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood - a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Dawn even existed! When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over.$B$BUnderstand this, $N, when rage and retribution take the reins, a man ceases to be a man. The man personifies the emotions that control him instead. And so it would be that Ramaladni, the spirit of retribution, would enter Naxxramas to exact vengeance... and never return.$B$BEnter Naxxramas and find what became of Ramaladni.
english.progress: Any news of Ramaladni?
english.completion: It is his ring! But it is destroyed. No other evidence of Ramaladni was found?$B$B<Korfax grimaces.>$B$BThis does not bode well for Ramaladni. The ring, however... it might be salvageable.

text.title: 拉玛兰迪的寒冰之握
text.objectives: 东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的科尔法克斯要1个冰冻符文、1块蓝宝石和1块奥金锭。
text.description: 要修复这枚戒指可不是件容易的事儿，$N。瞧，它的原材料是取自天灾建筑物中形成的冰冻符文，例如纳克萨玛斯的宫殿。当然我还需要其它材料，但是你的主要任务就是找到冰冻符文。把我所需的材料拿来，我会让这枚戒指重新恢复光泽的。
text.progress: 在纳克萨玛斯里应该可以找到冰冻符文。
text.completion: 就连罗马拉丁尼他自己也不可能做的比这个更完美!就像我所承诺的，我已经把这颗戒指恢复了他原有的光芒甚至更好，希望他能给你更多的帮助。
text.completed: 去找东瘟疫之地的科尔法克斯，圣光之勇士。

english.title: Ramaladni's Icy Grasp
english.objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 1 Frozen Rune, 1 Blue Sapphire and 1 Arcanite Bar.$B
english.description: Fixing this band may prove to be quite challenging, $N. You see, it was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures - like Naxxramas. Additional materials are also required but your main concern should be getting those frozen runes. Bring me what I need and I will restore the ring to its former glory.
english.progress: Frozen runes could probably be found inside Naxxramas.
english.completion: Ramaladni himself couldn't have done better! Here is the ring, as promised.

text.title: 我只会唱这一首歌……
text.objectives: 将2个冰冻符文、2个水之精华、2块蓝宝石和30金币交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。
text.description: 你自诩为银色黎明的英雄，是吗？克尔苏加德手下的小喽啰能轻松砍翻我军最优秀的士兵，这是我亲眼所见！像你这样的蠢货还想去纳克萨玛斯的宫殿？$B$B<威尔海姆叹了一口气。>$B$B呸，我还能有什么选择？你是我惟一的希望；我或许能帮上忙。$B$B“奥玛里恩悄悄地走，除了一份图样，他什么都没留……”，我只会唱这一首歌……嗯，我可以为你制作一条很棒的裤子，但是你得为我提供材料。
text.progress: 你还没见过工匠大师欧玛利安，对吧?
text.completion: <维尔海姆擦了一下额头上的汗。>$B$B呼，制作这件束裤比我想象中的难!希望这束裤能帮上你的忙，$C。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。

english.title: The Only Song I Know...
english.objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
english.description: You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas?$B$B<Wilhelm sighs.>$B$BBah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you.$B$BOmarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
english.progress: You haven't run into Omarion, have you?
english.completion: <Wilhelm wipes the sweat from his brow.>$B$BThat's some hard work! Enjoy the pants, $C. At least you'll die in a clean pair now.

text.title: 奥玛里恩的手册
text.objectives: 将奥玛里恩的手册交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的工匠威尔海姆。
text.description: 威尔海姆：$B$B当你翻阅这本手册时，我已经咽气了——这对我来说是个解脱。我想告诉你，我临死前还想着你和你那糟糕的商业头脑。不幸的是，就工匠技能来说，送手册给你的家伙连你都不如。$B$B这本手册记载了我生前研制的配方，可以让手册的持有者制造出任何他们想要的东西。我想你一定会向别人收取高额费用的，因为你就是这么个混帐。$B$B我鄙视你，$B$B奥玛里恩
text.progress: 这跟我想的是一样的吗?$B$B<维尔海姆流口水貌。>
text.completion: 他在纂写这本手册的时候一定是发疯了吧!我和欧玛利安－我们可是贼世至尊呢!$B$B总而言之，这也为我们开创了新的契机，$N。我现在可以制造更多新样式的物品了－当然，要付一点工资和材料费。

english.title: Omarion's Handbook
english.objectives: Take Omarion's Handbook to Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B
english.description: Wilhelm,$B$BIf you are reading this, I have perished - finally. I want you to know that my dying thoughts revolved around you and your ineptitude when it comes to tradeskills. Unfortunately, the bearer of this handbook is in even worse shape than you in regards to crafting.$B$BAbout the book: These are the rest of my recipes. Make the bearer of this book whatever they request. I'm sure you will charge a hefty fee for your services because you are, after all, a bastard.$B$BIn Disdain,$B$BOmarion
english.progress: Is that what I think it is?$B$B<Wilhelm appears to be drooling.>
english.completion: He musta really been off his rocker when he wrote this! Omarion and I - we were thick as thieves!$B$BAnyhow, this certainly opens up some new possibilities, $N. I am now able to craft more items - for a small fee and material charges, of course.

text.title: The Keeper's Call
text.objectives: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
text.description: $N,$B$BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.$B$B$N, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
text.progress: Ah, $n, it is good to see you.
text.completion: Simply by answering the call, we are in your debt, $n. The Argent Dawn is certain that through your shining example, others that are here to aid us will gain great insight into how best to throw back this Scourge Invasion!

text.title: 谦卑的馈赠
text.objectives: 将一根深渊节杖交给希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的奥蕾尔·金叶。你在塞纳里奥议会的声望必须达到尊敬。
text.description: Ishnu-alah，$R。让我看看能证明你杀死深渊议会领主的证据，我就奖励你一件好东西，它能在你与其拉虫人作战时帮你一臂之力。
text.progress: (达纳苏斯语)报上名来?喔，请原谅我，$N。我没有认出你来。你拿到权杖了吗?
text.completion: 安德索拉斯-尔西斯，在我母语里的意思是代表“愿你的烦恼减至最低”。$B$B骄傲地戴上戒指，保佑你健健康康，$N。
text.completed: 去希利苏斯找塞纳里奥要塞的奥蕾尔·金叶。

english.title: A Humble Offering
english.objectives: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
english.description: Ishnu-alah, $r. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
english.progress: Fandu-dath-belore? Oh, pardon me, $N. I did not recognize you. Have you the scepter?$B
english.completion: Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.$B$BWear the band proudly and in good health, $N.

text.title: 埃提耶什之杖
text.objectives: 看看有谁能帮你找到法杖的最后两个部分，并且净化邪恶的力量。
text.description: 合成杖柄之后，从形状上来看，守护者的传说之杖埃提耶什只差法杖顶部和杖柄末端两个部分了。还有个小问题就是：这根杖子蕴涵着萨格拉斯的邪恶力量。$B$B看看有谁能帮你找到残馀的法杖碎片并且净化那些邪恶的力量。
text.progress: 她的时辰到了，凡人。
text.completion: 大法师已经死了。$B$B别为他们的死而哀伤，$N。这一切都是命。就好像你手握守护者之杖也是命中注定……

english.title: Frame of Atiesh
english.objectives: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
english.description: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.$B$BFind someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
english.progress: It was her time, mortal.
english.completion: The archmages have died.$B$BDo not mourn their passing, $N. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...

text.title: 埃提耶什，被玷污的传说之杖
text.objectives: 塔纳利斯时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯要你找到埃提耶什的法杖顶部和埃提耶什的杖柄末端。
text.description: 你很困惑为何自己还活在世上吧。毕竟，你拥有这么一件邪恶的物品。没有确切的答案，$N。我只是做我应该做的事儿罢了。$B$B克尔苏加德就在纳克萨玛斯宫殿的王座上策划着某个阴谋……他要找的东西在你手中，而你要找的东西在他手中。$B$B一位名叫布莱恩·铜须的矮人曾携带杖柄的末端进入安其拉，却不小心将它遗失在了安其拉里面。$B$B一旦你成功拿到杖柄末端，就立即来找我吧。
text.progress: 以现状来看，法杖落在人类手上实在是太危险了。
text.completion: 里面有一个东西……一个不存在于世界上的东西。
text.completed: 去塔纳利斯找时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯。

english.title: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
english.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.
english.description: You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, $N. I only do as I must.$B$BKel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.$B$BAs for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.$B$BShould you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.
english.progress: In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.
english.completion: There is a being within... a being not of this world.

text.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
text.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
text.description: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.$B$BTake the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

text.title: 血帆海盗的叛徒
text.progress: 里维加兹那个肮脏的家伙已经饶恕了所有愿意改过自新的血帆!那船底的人渣要我去杀了其它的人并把他们的面罩带回来做为证据。$B$B我不想这么做，所以也不会叫你去做。帮我带来一些丝绸和红色染料，我就能制作合适的复制品。我会跟男爵说你变节了，但是请小心……血帆不会喜欢这个主意的!
text.completion: 让我们为这些阵亡的朋友哀悼，$N。$B$B<血帆背叛者对你咧嘴笑了笑，使了个眼色。>$B$B当一个背叛者是一回事，杀死你自己的兄弟……那才是真正可鄙的事!
text.completed: 去找荆棘谷的血帆叛徒。

english.title: Traitor to the Bloodsail
english.progress: That mangy dog, Revilgaz, has offered to pardon any former Bloodsails willing to turn on their cap'n! That bilge sucker asked me to go an' off me ole' mates and to bring back their bandannas as proof.$B$BI don't have it in me heart to do that, nor will I ask ye to. Bring me some silk cloth and red dye and I'll make suitable replicas. I'll tell the Baron you went turncoat, but be warned... the Bloodsails are not gonna like it!
english.completion: Let us observe a minute of silence for our fallen mates, $N.$B$B<The Bloodsail Traitor grins at you and winks.>$B$BBeing a traitor is one thing, murdering yer own buckos... that'd be just downright despicable, aye!

text.title: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
text.objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
text.description: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
text.progress: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
text.completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane.  The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

english.objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
english.description: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Darnassus from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. text.title: 痛改前非
text.progress: 你一定是对我们或我们的朋友做了什么可怕的事，$N。无论如何，我是来提供你一个方法赢回我们的好感。$B$B你知道，冬泉谷还满冷的。我们有这么多的哥布尔从别的城市过来，需要一些帮忙来保持温暖。帮我带一些符文布和煤炭来我就会帮你说点好话。不过要小心，我们的敌人不会对你的帮忙产生好感的。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。你很快就重拾我们城镇对你的好感了。
text.completed: 去找冬泉谷的布隆恩·菲兹维克。

english.title: Making Amends
english.progress: You must've done something really bad to us or our friends, $N. At any rate, I'm here to offer you a way to get our good graces back.$B$BAs you know, Winterspring is quite cold. With so many of us goblins coming from other cities, we could use a hand keeping warm. Bring me some runecloth and coal and I'll put in the good word for ya. Be warned though, our enemies are not going to take kindly to your helping us.
english.completion: Thank you, $N. You're on a quick path to redeeming yourself with our fair town.

text.title: 抚平旧伤
text.progress: 你在到达棘齿城之前要考虑清楚，$N!到处都传言着你的肮脏行为。$B$B不过你运气不错，刚好有一艘和血帆海盗交战过、载满伤者的船只抵达。这是你证明自己不是彻底的坏蛋的机会。帮我们把制作绷带的亚麻布和装药水的空瓶子拿来。
text.completion: 我很高兴你这样弥补自身的过错，$N。继续将物资送来;我们不会那么容易忘记你的，先生!
text.completed: 去贫瘠之地找棘齿城的穆普斯·沙克菲德。

english.title: Mending Old Wounds
english.progress: You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, $n! Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds.$B$BYou're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel. Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.
english.completion: I'm happy you're seeing the error of your ways, $N. Keep the supplies coming; we're not going to forget about you so easily, $Gmister:miss;!

text.title: 海上的战争
text.progress: 你想再次与塔纳利斯的哥布尔交朋友吗，$N?我们正需要航海的材料和击败旧仇血帆海盗的枪枝。帮我把魔纹和强效助熔剂拿来，我们就能赦免你的罪过。
text.completion: 继续保持，$N。我们哥布尔没那么健忘!
text.completed: 去找塔纳利斯的卢森·费兹布拉克。

english.title: War at Sea
english.progress: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, $N? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.
english.completion: Keep it coming, $N. Us goblins don't forget that easily!

text.title: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
text.objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
text.description: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.$B$BTake the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

text.title: Dressing the Part
text.completion: Yarrr... if ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard! Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide.$B$BThese'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben. Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea.$B$BWear 'em with pride, mate!

text.title: 破碎的死灵水晶
text.objectives: 将破碎的死灵水晶交给暴风城门外的奥林中尉。
text.description: 你在憎恶的尸体上找到一块散发着腐坏能量的破碎水晶。
text.progress: 你需要协助吗?
text.completion: 嗯，你从一具受到憎恨侵袭的尸体身上取得这项物品?$B$B我们已听说天灾军团召唤亡域基础营地的事。我猜他们想在暴风城里也造一个。很好，这样他们就等着迎接失败吧。

english.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal
english.objectives: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
english.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
english.progress: Is there something you need?
english.completion: Hm, you took this from the corpse of one of the invading abominations?$B$BWe have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they wanted to create one inside Stormwind. It is good that they were unseccessful.

text.title: Letter from the Front
text.objectives: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
text.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
text.progress: Yes? What do you have there?
text.completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.$B$BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...$B$BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

text.title: 潦草的便笺
text.objectives: 将潦草的便笺交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的名单登记员。
text.description: 你在某个天灾士兵的尸体上找到了这封信。破旧发黄的信纸散发着霉臭，看来它在亡灵手里已经有些日子了。或许圣光之愿礼拜堂的家伙会对此感兴趣的……
text.progress: 什么事吗?你手里拿着的是什么?
text.completion:
多悲哀啊
。这些话语，清楚的是要传达给某个士兵深爱的人，只是它永远也到不了目的地了。里面写的事情是多年前发生的;我不确定原本的收件者是否还活着。$B$B不过，还是有希望。有他写的名字和讯息，我大概可以找到那户人家 !需要一点时间调查，不过暴风城的图书馆员还欠我个人情……$B$B谢谢你把这个带来给我。有你的帮忙，我们终于能让某人的心灵得到平静。

text.completion: 多悲哀啊。这些话语，清楚的是要传达给某个士兵深爱的人，只是它永远也到不了目的地了。里面写的事情是多年前发生的;我不确定原本的收件者是否还活着。$B$B不过，还是有希望。有他写的名字和讯息，我大概可以找到那户人家 !需要一点时间调查，不过暴风城的图书馆员还欠我个人情……$B$B谢谢你把这个带来给我。有你的帮忙，我们终于能让某人的心灵得到平静。

english.title: Document from the Front
english.objectives: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
english.progress: Yes? What do you have there?
english.completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.$B$BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...$B$BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

text.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal
text.objectives: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
text.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
text.progress: Can I help you with something?
text.completion: You say this was taken from a wight attacking the city?$B$BWe have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they were trying to create one in the Undercity. We will have to be vigilant in the future.

text.title: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
text.progress: If you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King.
text.completion: Thank you, $N. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.

english.completion: Thank you, $N. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.

text.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
text.progress: In exchange for the necrotic runes of the Scourge invaders, the Argent Dawn will give you one vial of blessed wizard oil.
text.completion: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.

english.completion: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.

text.title: 黑暗中的光明
text.objectives: 找到并碰触在黑石塔、厄运之槌、通灵学院和斯坦索姆内的火盆，并回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 我们不是这世界上唯一庆祝这个节日的人， $n。所有种族，所有文化，都曾为火焰的寓意所深深触动。即使是在这世界上最阴暗、最寒冷的处所，仍有明亮的火焰在跳动。$b$b如果你想自己证实这一点，就到那些地下城里去看看吧。去看看通灵学院、斯坦索姆、黑石塔和厄运之槌厅堂内的篝火，我会在这里等你回来的。
text.progress: 你找到你在黑暗中的路了吗?
text.completion: 你的本质和你所找到的火焰能量共鸣着，$N。你找到的火焰相当强大，只需要正确地处理，就能增强它的力量……$B$B<老者对着空气中低语，然后拿出一个发光的瓶子。>$B$B啊!好了。不管你往何处去，愿它照亮你的道路。
text.completed: 去找大地之环长者。

english.title: A Light in Dark Places
english.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, $n. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.$B$BIf you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
english.progress: Have you found your way through the dark?
english.completion: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

text.title: Major Mana Potion
text.progress: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major mana potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
text.completion: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.
