text.title: 卡利姆多的野火
text.objectives: 造访艾萨拉、希利苏斯、安戈洛环行山和冬泉谷的仲夏庆典营地，然后回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯世界上的每一处地方都会庆祝仲夏的来临，广袤的卡利姆多大陆也是如此，或许你会有兴趣那那边看一看。$b$b若你没有真正地感受过那些熊熊燃烧着的火焰，那么你是无法彻底了解仲夏的。庆祝者已经在寒冷的冬泉谷西部、艾萨拉东北部、希利苏斯废土上的勇士之墓附近，以及富饶美丽的安戈洛环行山入口处都点起了火焰，去看看吧。你的旅程结束以后，别忘了回来找我。
text.progress: 卡利姆多的火焰烧地旺吗?
text.completion: 你的精神闪耀着卡利姆多火焰温暖的光，朋友。热度不够鼓舞你吗?$B$B一旦力量从你身上褪去，或许这些能够帮你重新振作感觉。
text.completed: 去找节日护火者。

english.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
english.objectives: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$B$BMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
english.progress: Are the flames of Kalimdor burning brightly?
english.completion: Your spirit glows with the warmth of the Kalimdor fires, friend. Is the heat not invigorating? Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.

text.title: 东部王国的野火
text.objectives: 造访诅咒之地、东瘟疫之地、辛特兰和灼热峡谷的火焰节营地，然后回到节日护火者处。
text.description: 我们的庆典已经在全世界展开了，$c。几乎每一处地方都已经点燃了圣火，在节日光辉的照耀之下，强大的火焰映射着明亮的蓝天。去寻找它们吧。$b$b有一处就在黑石塔的北方。其它的火焰，有的在东瘟疫之地一处衰败的城镇前，有的在辛特兰悬崖的路旁，还有在诅咒之地的黑暗之门附近。$b$b去寻找它们吧，旅程结束后回来找我。
text.progress: 你在大陆上旅行了吗?启蒙等待着你。
text.completion: 啊，你来了。有点疲倦，有点脏乱，但是很有知识!热情在这个季节都深触我们的心并让我们团结在一起;你的人也和你所触摸的火焰一起发光发热。$B$B啊，但是这年头教化已经不是出任务很好的奖励了，我想。收下这些，然后，尽情在庆典上玩乐吧。
text.completed: 去找节日护火者。

english.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
english.objectives: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$B$BYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$B$B Return once your journey is done.
english.progress: It will take time to prevail against this threat. How have you fared, $N?
english.completion: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched. Ah, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.

text.title: 盗取奥格瑞玛的烈焰
text.objectives: 将奥格瑞玛烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从奥格瑞玛中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion: 这是什么?要是我没猜错，这个火焰应该是从奥格瑞玛中心拿到的吧!它燃烧的热度反映出兽人和巨魔凶猛的内心。真是为我们的收集品画龙点睛 -

english.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame!

text.title: 盗取雷霆崖的烈焰
text.objectives: 将雷霆崖烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从雷霆崖萨满祭司身上偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion: 除非我猜错了，否则这个火焰应该是从雷霆崖的悬崖边拿到的!听听它和精神力量的共鸣!你真是个厉害的窃贼，$N。收下这个做为你的奖励。现在，如果我们能有全部四个城市的火焰……

english.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, $N. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...

text.title: 盗取幽暗城的烈焰
text.objectives: 将幽暗城烈焰交给节日博学者。
text.description: 从幽暗城上面的洛丹伦废墟偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是博学者或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion: 嗯……真是把奇怪的火焰!它很柔和，几乎是无火苗的闷烧，但它的中心又很强烈。你说你是从幽暗城取得它的吗?好极了。如果有了全部四个城市的火焰，谁知道我们能怎么样?

english.title: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?

text.title: 盗取暴风城的烈焰
text.objectives: 将暴风城烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从暴风城中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion: 这把烧地明亮的火焰……你说这是从暴风城来的?了不起!那一定是趟真正的冒险!当然，我会给你一点报酬。如果你又找到这样类似的东西，记得再来和我谈谈。

english.title: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.

text.title: 盗取铁炉堡的烈焰
text.objectives: 将铁炉堡烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从铁炉堡中心偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion: 这个热烈的火焰一定是从铁炉堡的大厅来的;它和那些矮人一样坚定。做的好，$N。如果我有其它城市的火焰……啊，没事。这是你的酬劳。

english.title: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, $N. If I had the fires of the other cities... ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.

text.title: 盗取达纳苏斯的烈焰
text.objectives: 将达纳苏斯烈焰交给节日诗人。
text.description: 从泰达希尔海岸边偷来的烈焰令你感到异常的温暖。你对这种罕见的力量一无所知，但是诗人或许知道些什么……
text.progress: 你几乎在发着光芒，$r。你带了什么来?
text.completion:
这把火烧着古老的哀伤，$N。你说你是从泰达希尔根部拉出这个的吗?好极了
!这是你努力的奖励。如果你找到任何像这样的东西就再来找我;我或许会有些用途。

english.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
english.objectives: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
english.description: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
english.progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
english.completion: This fire aches of ancient sorrow, $N. You pulled this from the roots of Teldrassil, you say? Fascinating! Here is a reward for your skill. Return to me should you find anything else like this; I may have a use for it.

text.title: Argent Dawn Gloves
text.progress: If you bring me thirty necrotic runes, I will give you your choice of hand protection in return. These should prove valuable in our fight against the undead Scourge.
text.completion: You've done well, $N. Take your pick of hand protection in thanks for your efforts.

text.title: 塞纳里奥议会的盟友
text.progress: 即使你对我们提供的奖励没有兴趣，这些徽章仍象征着我们互相的信任和友谊。$B$B把它们带来给我。如果你的职责表现良好，我会做好应有的记录的。
text.completion: 你为我们带来荣耀，$N。有你持续的努力我们会克服所有障碍的。
text.completed: 去找希利苏斯的唤风者卡尔东。

english.title: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle
english.progress: Even if you have no need for the material rewards we offer, these badges still mark our mutual trust and friendship.$B$BBring them to me.  I'll make due note of your service should your performance go above and beyond the call of duty.
english.completion: You honor us, $N. With your continued efforts we will overcome all obstacles.

text.title: A Thief's Reward
text.completion: You've proven yourself, today, $n.$b$bWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

english.title: A Thief's Reward
english.completion: You've proven yourself, today, $n.$b$bWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

text.title: Tabard of the Argent Dawn
text.progress: You have aided our cause greatly, $N. If you wish, I can make available the tabard of the Argent Dawn. We are proud to have you among our allies.
text.completion: Take this tabard and wear it proudly. Perhaps your deeds might inspire others to take up arms in support of our fight against the Scourge.

text.title: 军阀克雷利安
text.objectives: 为大法师克希雷姆夺回虹彩贝壳。大法师克希雷姆就居住在艾萨拉北部悬崖上的一座塔中。
text.description: 没什么时间了，$n！我的探知法术最近发现了一个很强大的法术源。但我却不能离开法师塔，所以只有请你帮我杀死那个占有这件神器的邪恶生物。$b$b这个邪恶的家伙名叫军阀克雷利安，他躲藏在守卫森严的辛玛洛神殿。把他烧成灰，然后将他垂涎已久的虹彩贝壳给我带回来。
text.progress: 没有时间可以浪费了!你拿到贝壳了吗?
text.completion: 我必须说，这个贝壳有一种奇怪的光环。看来要奖励你取得它的一部分报酬就是派你去测试它的魔法潜力……
text.completed: 去艾萨拉找在熊头的大法师克希雷姆。

english.title: Warlord Krellian
english.objectives: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
english.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$B$BThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor.  Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
english.progress: There is not time to waste! Have you the shell?
english.completion: I must say, this shell has a strange aura. It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...

text.title: 魔法的碎片
text.objectives: 对艾萨拉的恶鞭纳迦使用变形术，然后杀死几秒钟后出现的相似体。当你杀了50个相似体后，回去向大法师克希雷姆复命。
text.description: 我的研究发现了这个虹彩贝壳的一个特殊用途。$b$b带上这个贝壳，到艾萨拉四处找一些恶鞭纳迦，使用一下变形术看看。如果你愿意等一段时间，那么这个贝壳上所附带的光环会使他们分裂为几个小一些的相似物体。尽快杀死这些物体，贝壳就可以收集它们的精华。$b$b等贝壳满了之后，回来找我。
text.progress: 你收集到那些魔法了吗?
text.completion: 太棒了!太棒了!$B$B现在我们就可以重新将这魔法组成新的法术。看啊!
text.completed: 去艾萨拉找在熊头的大法师克希雷姆。

english.title: Fragmented Magic
english.objectives: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later.  When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
english.description: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.$B$BCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara.  If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments.  Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.$B$BWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
english.progress: Have you collected the magic?
english.completion: Splendid! Splendid!$B$BNow we are able to reform this magic into a new spell. Behold!

text.title: A Thief's Reward
text.completion: You've proven yourself, today, $n.$b$bWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

english.title: A Thief's Reward
english.completion: You've proven yourself, today, $n.$b$bWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

text.title: 火焰的节日
text.objectives: 碰触暴风城、铁炉堡和达纳苏斯城里的篝火，然后与城市内的节日博学者交谈。
text.description: 仲夏就要来了！$b$b每一年，按照传统，各大城市里都会选出护火者来照看我们城中的篝火。当火焰燃烧在艾泽拉斯世界的各处时，我们就可以通过这种世上最热诚也最明亮的事物向夏天这个季节表示敬意。$b$b事实上，若你不介意的话，我有个任务要交给你。我还不知道是否所有城市里的火焰都已经点起了。到各大城市去吧，让那里的火焰温暖你的身躯，当然，首先要确认它们已经被点燃了！
text.progress: 火焰都发烫着吗?
text.completion: 太好了!如果那些营火真的如你们所说的那样炽热的燃烧着，看来我们今年指派的火焰管理器都很尽责。谢谢你帮我去调查;来，收下这个做为我一点小意思。
text.completed: 去找节日博学者。

english.title: The Festival of Fire
english.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
english.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$B$BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$B$BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
english.progress: Are the fires burning?
english.completion: Excellent! It seems we've appointed dutiful Flamekeepers this year if the bonfires are as well-kept as you claim. Thank you for inspecting them for me; here, take this as a small token of my esteem.

text.title: 火焰的节日
text.objectives: 碰触奥格瑞玛、雷霆崖和幽暗城里的篝火，然后与城市内的节日诗人交谈。
text.description: 仲夏就要来了！$b$b每一年，按照传统，各大城市里都会选出护火者来照看我们城中的篝火。当火焰燃烧在艾泽拉斯世界的各处时，我们就可以通过这种世上最热诚也最明亮的事物向夏天这个季节表示敬意。$b$b事实上，若你不介意的话，我有个任务要交给你。我还不知道是否所有城市里的火焰都已经点起了。到各大城市去吧，让那里的火焰温暖你的身躯，当然，首先要确认它们已经被点燃了！
text.progress: 火焰都发烫着吗?
text.completion: 太好了!如果那些营火真的如你们所说的那样炽热的燃烧着，看来我们今年指派的火焰管理器都很尽责。谢谢你帮我去调查;来，收下这个做为我一点小意思。
text.completed: 去找节日诗人。

english.title: The Festival of Fire
english.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
english.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$B$BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$B$BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
english.progress: Have you had any luck, $N?
english.completion: Excellent work, $N. With the shadows destroyed, it can only be a matter of time before the Lich King decides to recall his necropolises and leave us in peace.

text.title: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
text.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
text.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.

english.title: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
english.objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
english.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.

text.title: A Light in Dark Places
text.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
text.description: An eager one, aren't you? If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you.$B$BSeek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I look forward to your return, $n.
text.progress: Have you found your way through the dark?
text.completion: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

english.title: A Light in Dark Places
english.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: An eager one, aren't you? If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you.$B$BSeek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I look forward to your return, $n.
english.progress: Have you found your way through the dark?
english.completion: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

text.title: 卡利姆多的火焰
text.objectives: 造访灰谷、贫瘠之地、黑海岸和石爪山的篝火堆，然后回来与节日护火者交谈。
text.description: 今天，全世界上各处有无数的火焰在熊熊燃烧着，$n。那些最狡诈的火焰往往都是绿色的，如果不小心照看的话，它们很快就会灭掉。为我们的护火者确认一下卡利姆多上的几处翡翠烈焰是否还在燃烧着，好吗？$b$b你能在贫瘠之地的棘齿城、黑海岸的主宰之剑、银翼岗哨附近的桥，以及石爪山尘风峡谷的路旁去寻找这样的篝火堆。
text.progress: 庆典结束之前火焰都不能熄灭!
text.completion: 啊，所以它们真的还在燃烧。我很高兴;时间没到之前那些火焰不能熄灭。你做的很好，$N。收下这个和我的祝福。
text.completed: 去找节日护火者。

english.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor
english.objectives: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $n. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$B$BYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.progress: The fires cannot die until the festival is done!
english.completion: Ahhh, so they do still burn. I am glad; it would not do for those fires to burn out before their time. You have done well, $N. Take this with my blessing.

text.title: 东部王国的火焰
text.objectives: 造访希尔斯布莱德丘陵、银松森林、西部荒野和湿地的篝火堆，然后回来与节日护火者交谈。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节的传统就是建起一座金字塔状的火焰。有些人说绿色的火焰是最好的，因为它们最难以维持燃烧，而且有着如此美丽的颜色。$b$b你去为我们的护火者确认一下东部王国的绿色火焰是否都在正常燃烧吧。它们分别座落于湿地的丹莫德，银松森林的焚木村旁，西部荒野能望见灯塔的悬崖边，以及希尔斯布莱德那座被废弃的哨塔边。
text.progress: 你完成你的任务了吗?
text.completion: 你回来了，也见过大陆上翠绿色的火焰了。你觉得怎么样呢?确切的说，那是一种罕见又美好的景象。不过，我知道，还是要有实质的奖励比较好……那么拜托你，收下这个做为奖励。
text.completed: 去找节日护火者。

english.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms
english.objectives: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$B$BMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.progress: Have you seen to your task?
english.completion: So you've returned, and you've seen to the emerald flames of the continent. What do you think, mm? A rare and wonderful sight, to be certain. I am aware, however, that tangible rewards are better appreciated... so please, take this for your trouble.

text.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall
text.objectives: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
text.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$B$BWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$B$BNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
text.completion: The Alliance needs every able body they can get. The Horde has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.$B$BLet me explain the situation to you.

english.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall
english.objectives: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
english.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$B$BWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$B$BNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
english.completion: The Alliance needs every able body they can get. The Horde has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.$B$BLet me explain the situation to you.

text.title: Report to General Kirika
text.objectives: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
text.description: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.$B$BThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.$B$BGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
text.completion: It's good that you're here, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.$B$BListen up.

english.title: Report to General Kirika
english.objectives: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
english.description: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.$B$BThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.$B$BGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
english.completion: It's good that you're here, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.$B$BListen up.

text.title: 横扫沙漠
text.objectives: 找到一份水晶尘，将其送到水晶尘萃取器那里，然后向佐拉虫巢外联盟营地的布鲁沃尔元帅复命。
text.description: 最近我们发现部落正在希利苏斯的沙漠上进行一些扫荡行动，以争夺宝贵的资源，不过不必担心这些家伙。我们不认为他们值得我军在酷热的沙漠上派驻大批兵员。$b$b但是，资源的重要性却是不容质疑的，我们也决定做出一些行动。$b$b如果你有能力的话，立刻进入沙漠地区，夺回一些希利苏斯水晶尘，然后回到这里。
text.progress: 在那里动作要小心，但也要快速。我们没有时间可以浪费。
text.completion: 感谢圣光你成功了。$B$B如果我们可以早点这么做，我们的需求就不会如此迫切了。我们绝对不能让沙漠里的物资落入部落手中。
text.completed: 去找希利苏斯的布鲁沃尔元帅。

english.title: Scouring the Desert
english.objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
english.description: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.$B$BHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.$B$BIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
english.progress: Be careful out there, but also be quick. We have no time to lose.
english.completion: Thank the Light you were successful.$B$BNow if we could only have started this sooner, our need would not be so desperate. We must keep the bounty of the desert from falling into the hands of the Horde.

text.title: 横扫沙漠
text.objectives: 找到一份水晶尘，将其送到水晶尘萃取器那里，然后向雷戈虫巢外部落营地的吉里卡将军复命。
text.description: 不久以前，我们开始吸收希利苏斯沙漠中水晶资源的力量。过去，开采过程中唯一遇到的危险不过是那些以沙漠为家的野兽，以及沙漠的干旱和炎热。$b$b但现在联盟似乎也开始争夺这些我们先发现的东西了。现在看来，我们正在展开一场竞赛，双方都想要彻底占领这些资源，并防止它们落入对方的手中。$b$b我需要一切可以依靠的力量，希望你能帮助我。
text.progress: 小心沙漠里的危险，$N。有联盟在沙丘里埋伏，你的任何一步都可能是最后一步。
text.completion: 你做的很好，$N。这些资源会加入我们的库存之中，每一分都是我们的优势，敌人的弱势。
text.completed: 去希利苏斯找雷戈虫巢的吉里卡将军。

english.title: Scouring the Desert
english.objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
english.description: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$B$BBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$B$BI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
english.progress: Be wary of the dangers of the desert, $n. With the Alliance lurking in the dunes, any step could be your last.
english.completion: You've done well, $N. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.

text.title: 建立新据点
text.objectives: 夺取东瘟疫之地的皇冠哨塔、东墙哨塔、北地哨塔和病木林哨塔，然后向圣光之愿礼拜堂的白须大使复命。
text.description: 欢迎来到瘟疫之地，$n。正如你所知，被遗忘者和他们的盟友控制着西边的土地，并与我们互相抗衡。联盟的指挥官们决定在东部建立数个新的据点，以加强我们在敌人外圈的包围网。$b$b洛丹伦战争后期被废弃的那些哨塔正好用来达成这个目标。不过，这些地方都非常危险，我们需要你的帮助。
text.progress: 等哨塔在我们的控制之下时，我们很快就能包围被遗忘者。在那之后，粉碎他们就是迟早的事了。
text.completion: 很好，$N。握有这些哨塔防止更多的攻击对我们而言是很重要的，为达此目的，在援军前来保卫这里前我们都需要你的帮助。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的白须大使。

english.title: Establishing New Outposts
english.objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
english.description: Welcome to the Plaguelands, $n. As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.$B$BTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
english.progress: When the towers are under our control, we will soon be able to surround the Forsaken. After that, it is only a matter of time before we can crush them.
english.completion: Very good, $N. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.

text.title: 加强防御
text.objectives: 夺取东瘟疫之地的皇冠哨塔、东墙哨塔、北地哨塔和病木林哨塔，然后向圣光之愿礼拜堂的高莫克大使复命。
text.description: 被遗忘者的密探发现，最近联盟试图在东瘟疫之地利用那些废弃的哨塔创建一系列的据点。$b$b现在，情况非常急迫，我们显然不能允许他们在我们东部边界的一系列重要地点创建这样的据点，因此我们必须击退联盟的这次进犯，并把他们赶出那些已经被占据的哨塔，同时，我们还要将那些哨塔占领下来，以应对以后的进攻。
text.progress: 他们一定是白痴才认为我们会让他们在离我们主城那么近的地方创建基地。$B$B我们会赶尽杀绝直到他们夹着尾巴逃回南方去。
text.completion: 这是好消息，$N。在我们将联盟军队完全赶离瘟疫之地前这里会一直争战不休。$B$B在那天到来之前，我希望我们能获得你持续的帮助。
text.completed: 去东瘟疫之地找圣光之愿礼拜堂的高莫克大使。

english.title: Bolstering Our Defenses
english.objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
english.description: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.$B$BIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
english.progress: They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.$B$BWe will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.
english.completion: This is good news, $N. It will be a constant struggle here in the Plaguelands until we have fully driven back the forces of the Alliance.$B$BUntil that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
